sub_graphs.title: EIP-779: DAO Fork Irregular State Change
sub_graphs.description: Models the irregular state change mechanism that transferred ether from DAO-related accounts to a recovery contract at a specific block number

nodes.label: Block 1,920,000 Reached
nodes.description: System has reached the DAO fork block number on mainnet, triggering the irregular state change

nodes.label: Identify DAO Accounts from List L
nodes.description: Identify all 115 child DAO contracts plus 4 principal accounts (main DAO, extraBalance, creator's child contracts) from the hardcoded list

nodes.label: DAO Accounts Identified
nodes.description: All accounts in List L have been identified for balance transfer

nodes.label: Transfer Ether to Recovery Contract
nodes.description: Transfer all ether from identified accounts to recovery contract 0xbf4ed7b27f1d666546e30d74d50d173d20bca754

nodes.label: Balances Transferred to Recovery
nodes.description: All ether from DAO accounts has been moved to the recovery contract

nodes.label: DAO Account Balances Zeroed
nodes.description: Original DAO accounts now have zero ether balance

edges.label: All accounts from List L enumerated

sub_graphs.title: EIP-779: DAO Fork Block Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for blocks during the DAO fork transition period

nodes.label: Block in Fork Range (1920000-1920009)
nodes.description: Block number is within the range requiring special extraData validation

nodes.label: Validate ExtraData Field
nodes.description: Check that block extraData contains the hex-encoded string 'dao-hard-fork'

nodes.label: ExtraData Valid
nodes.description: Block extraData contains required dao-hard-fork identifier

nodes.label: ExtraData Invalid
nodes.description: Block extraData missing required identifier, block rejected

nodes.label: Block Accepted
nodes.description: Block passes fork validation and is accepted into the chain

nodes.label: Block Rejected
nodes.description: Block fails fork validation and is rejected

edges.label: Block rejected due to invalid extraData

external_entities.name: Block Producer (Miner)
external_entities.description: Miner creating blocks must include dao-hard-fork in extraData during fork range

sub_graphs.title: EIP-779: WithdrawDAO Contract Recovery Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models how token holders can withdraw their recovered funds from the WithdrawDAO contract

nodes.label: Funds in Recovery Contract
nodes.description: Ether from DAO accounts is held in the WithdrawDAO recovery contract at 0xbf4ed7b27f1d666546e30d74d50d173d20bca754

nodes.label: Call withdraw() Function
nodes.description: Token holder calls the withdraw() function on the recovery contract

nodes.label: Check DAO Token Balance
nodes.description: Contract queries mainDAO to verify caller's DAO token balance

nodes.label: DAO Balance Verified
nodes.description: Caller's DAO token balance has been verified against mainDAO

nodes.label: Execute Ether Transfer
nodes.description: Transfer proportional ether to the caller based on their DAO token balance

nodes.label: Withdrawal Complete
nodes.description: User has successfully received their recovered ether

external_entities.name: DAO Token Holder
external_entities.description: Original holder of DAO tokens who is entitled to recovered ether

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior for clients that did not follow the fork (Ethereum Classic).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this EIP only applies to the mainnet chain that followed the fork. Clients on the minority chain would not implement this state change.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between 'List L' and the exact set of accounts is defined by reference to external data structures.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume List L is a fixed, immutable list of 115 child DAO contracts plus 4 principal accounts as specified in the reference implementation.

implicit_assumptions.description: The list of DAO accounts (List L) is complete and accurate, including all accounts that received ether from the DAO exploit.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the list is incomplete, some stolen funds would not be recovered. If over-inclusive, innocent accounts could lose funds.

implicit_assumptions.description: The WithdrawDAO contract at 0xbf4ed7b27f1d666546e30d74d50d173d20bca754 is correctly implemented and can properly distribute funds to token holders.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Funds could be locked, stolen, or incorrectly distributed if the recovery contract has bugs.

implicit_assumptions.description: Miners will include the required extraData field in blocks 1,920,000-1,920,009.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If miners produce blocks without the required extraData, the network could split between clients that enforce this rule and those that don't.
